about: The seat's own edge: Iron against Iron, the script on both seats, seats NOT swapped (a mirror from both seats is the same match twice), so a is seat 0, which walks up, and b is seat 1, which lands by boat. now: the old buying rule, the boats, the scene's ground (1917). walk: the sea lift off, both sides walk up. in-turn: the new buying rule. old-f@N / in-turn-f@N: another ground of the same kind, the boats on. walk-f@N: another ground, both walking. A seat should win as often as the other. Measured 2026-10-07 (decisions-evidence 2026-10-07 balance mixed-army): it does not, on most grounds.
